# Roamify eSIM API — Best eSIM API for Resellers, Travel Apps & White-Label eSIM Platforms | Full Documentation

> Roamify offers the best eSIM API for travel tech companies, eSIM resellers, B2B platforms, MVNOs, and white-label eSIM solutions. Instantly provision, activate, and manage eSIMs across 200+ countries. Supports eSIM wholesale purchasing, real-time eSIM activation, data top-ups, eSIM gift card issuance, affiliate commission tracking, live currency exchange rates, and event-driven webhook notifications. Built for developers who need a reliable, scalable global eSIM API.

Environments:
- Development: https://api-dev.getroamify.com
- Production: https://api.getroamify.com

All requests require:
- `Authorization: Bearer {your_access_token}`
- `Content-Type: application/json`

---

## Introduction — Best eSIM API for Travel Apps & eSIM Resellers

Source: https://docs.getroamify.com/

Roamify API is a RESTful eSIM API built for travel apps, eSIM resellers, MVNO platforms, and white-label eSIM businesses. With the Roamify eSIM API you can buy eSIM data plans programmatically, activate eSIM profiles instantly, check prepaid wallet balance, top up eSIMs, and manage your entire eSIM reseller operation at scale.

Supported modules:
- Authentication — secure eSIM API access with long-lived Bearer tokens
- eSIMs — global eSIM provisioning, activation, top-up, and lifecycle management
- Gift Cards — eSIM gift card issuance and management
- Exchange Rates — real-time and historical currency conversion for 100+ currencies
- Webhooks — real-time eSIM event notifications (status, usage, balance, affiliate orders)
- Affiliate — eSIM referral and affiliate commission tracking

### Postman Collection
https://www.postman.com/roamifyhq/roamify-developers/overview

### API Dog
https://roamify.apidog.io/

### Environments
- Development: https://api-dev.getroamify.com
- Production: https://api.getroamify.com

## eSIM API Authentication

Source: https://docs.getroamify.com/authentication/

Roamify eSIM API uses Bearer Token Authentication. All API requests from your travel app, eSIM reseller platform, or white-label eSIM integration must include your Access Token in the `Authorization` header.

### Authentication Flow
1. Retrieve your Access Token (called API Key) from https://partner.getroamify.com/sign-in
2. Include it as `Authorization: Bearer {access_token}` in all requests

### Access Token
Long-lived eSIM API key that does not expire. Only invalidated when manually refreshed in the Partner Portal under "API Keys". Ideal for server-side eSIM integrations.

### Usage Example

```bash
curl --request GET \
  --url 'https://api-dev.getroamify.com/api/esim/countries' \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer {access_token}' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json'
```

## eSIM API Overview — Global eSIM Provisioning, Activation & Management

Source: https://docs.getroamify.com/esims/overview/

The Roamify eSIM API is the most comprehensive eSIM API for travel apps, eSIM resellers, and B2B eSIM platforms. It covers the full eSIM lifecycle from browsing international eSIM data plans to instant eSIM activation, real-time usage monitoring, and data top-up — all via a simple REST API.

### Modules
- Countries — GET /api/esim/countries (200+ countries with eSIM coverage)
- Packages — GET /api/esim/packages (local, regional & global eSIM data plans)
- Orders — POST/GET /api/esim/order (eSIM wholesale orders & top-ups)
- eSIMs — POST /api/esim/apply (instant eSIM profile generation & activation)
- eSIM Events — GET /api/esim/events (full eSIM lifecycle history)
- eSIM Link — POST /api/esim/link (branded eSIM installation share links)
- Compatible Devices — GET /api/compatible-devices (eSIM device compatibility check)
- Balance — GET /api/balance (eSIM reseller prepaid wallet balance)

### Recommended eSIM Integration Flow

1. Get Access Token from Partner Portal
2. GET /api/esim/packages — browse global eSIM data plans (filter by country, region, days, GBs)
3. POST /api/esim/order — place eSIM wholesale order (`items[{packageId, quantity}]`, optional `referenceId`)
4. POST /api/esim/apply — instantly generate and activate eSIM profile (`esimId` or `referenceId`)
5. GET /api/esim?esimId=... — retrieve real-time eSIM data usage
6. GET /api/esim/packages?compatible=... — find compatible eSIM top-up packages
7. POST /api/esim/order — submit eSIM top-up order to extend data
8. GET /api/balance — check eSIM reseller prepaid wallet balance

## eSIM Countries — Global eSIM Coverage in 200+ Countries

Source: https://docs.getroamify.com/esims/countries/

Endpoint: `GET /api/esim/countries`

Retrieve the complete list of countries where Roamify eSIM data plans are available. Covers 200+ countries and territories worldwide, including popular travel destinations in Europe, Asia, Americas, Middle East, and Africa. No parameters required.

```bash
curl --request GET \
  --url 'https://api-dev.getroamify.com/api/esim/countries' \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer {access_token}' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json'
```

Sample Response:
```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "data": {
    "countries": [
      { "code": "AF", "name": "Afghanistan" },
      { "code": "AL", "name": "Albania" }
    ]
  }
}
```

## eSIM Packages — Browse Local, Regional & Global eSIM Data Plans

Source: https://docs.getroamify.com/esims/packages/

Endpoint: `GET /api/esim/packages`

Browse Roamify’s full catalog of eSIM data plans including local eSIM plans (single-country), regional eSIM plans (multi-country), and global eSIM plans (worldwide roaming). Ideal for travel eSIM apps, eSIM comparison platforms, and eSIM resellers listing international data packages.

Optional query parameters:
- `country` (string) — ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. `US`, `JP`, `GB`); filter eSIM plans by destination
- `geography` (string) — `local` (single-country eSIM) | `regional` (multi-country eSIM) | `global` (worldwide eSIM)
- `days` (number) — eSIM plan validity in days
- `gbs` (number) — data allocation in GB
- `isUnlimited` (boolean) — filter unlimited eSIM data plans
- `packageId` (string) — retrieve a specific eSIM package by ID

Notes:
- `withUsageCheck: false` means usage check is not supported (see `notes` property for instructions)
- `withThrottle: true` means throttling is in effect (see `throttle` property for details)

```bash
# All packages
curl --request GET \
  --url 'https://api-dev.getroamify.com/api/esim/packages' \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer {access_token}' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json'

# Filter by country
curl --request GET \
  --url 'https://api-dev.getroamify.com/api/esim/packages?country=US' \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer {access_token}' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json'
```

## eSIM Orders — Wholesale eSIM Purchasing & Top-Up API

Source: https://docs.getroamify.com/esims/orders/

### Create eSIM Order (Wholesale eSIM Purchase)

Endpoint: `POST /api/esim/order`

Place eSIM wholesale orders for any supported eSIM data plan. Used by eSIM resellers, travel apps, and B2B eSIM platforms to purchase eSIM inventory programmatically.

Required body:
- `items` (array) — each item: `{ packageId: string, quantity: number }`
- `referenceId` (string, optional) — your custom order reference ID for reconciliation

```bash
curl --request POST \
  --url 'https://api-dev.getroamify.com/api/esim/order' \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer {access_token}' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{
    "items": [{ "packageId": "PACKAGE_ID", "quantity": 1 }],
    "referenceId": "YOUR_REF_ID"
  }'
```

### Create eSIM Top-Up Order
Extend an existing active eSIM’s data plan. Same endpoint (`POST /api/esim/order`) with a top-up package ID and the target eSIM’s `iccid` or `esimId`. Enables seamless eSIM data top-up for travel customers running low on data.

### Create Instant eSIM Order
Creates an eSIM order and immediately generates and activates the eSIM profile in a single API call. Best for real-time eSIM purchasing flows in travel apps.

### Get eSIM Order
`GET /api/esim/order?orderId=ORDER_ID` — retrieve status and details of a specific eSIM order

### Get eSIM Orders
`GET /api/esim/orders` — retrieve full eSIM order history for your reseller account

## eSIM Management — Activate, Monitor & Manage eSIM Profiles

Source: https://docs.getroamify.com/esims/esims/

### Generate & Activate eSIM Profile

Endpoint: `POST /api/esim/apply`

Instantly generate and activate an eSIM profile ready for customer installation. Supports both single eSIM activation and bulk eSIM profile generation via `referenceId` — ideal for eSIM resellers processing high-volume orders.

Body:
- `esimId` (string, required) — eSIM ID from the order response
- `referenceId` (string, optional) — bulk activate all eSIMs in an order by reference ID

Note: eSIM profile generation can take up to 90 seconds. Set request timeout ≥ 90 seconds. If the request times out or returns "eSIM is still pending processing", poll with `GET /api/esim?esimId=YOUR_ESIM_ID`.

```bash
curl --request POST \
  --url 'https://api-dev.getroamify.com/api/esim/apply' \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer {access_token}' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{ "esimId": "ESIM_ID" }'
```

### Get eSIM Usage
`GET /api/esim/usage?esimId=ESIM_ID`

### Get eSIM Usage Details
`GET /api/esim/usage/details?esimId=ESIM_ID`

### Get eSIM Compatible Top-ups
`GET /api/esim/topups?iccid=ICCID`

### Get eSIM Packages History
`GET /api/esim/history?esimId=ESIM_ID`

### Get eSIM By ICCID
`GET /api/esim?iccid=ICCID`

### Get eSIM By esimId
`GET /api/esim?esimId=ESIM_ID`

### Get eSIMs List
`GET /api/esims`

## eSIM Sharing Link — Branded eSIM Installation Links for Customer Distribution

Source: https://docs.getroamify.com/esims/esims-link/

Endpoint: `POST /api/esim/link`

Generate a branded, shareable eSIM installation link to deliver eSIM profiles to your customers without requiring technical knowledge. Perfect for eSIM resellers distributing eSIMs via email, WhatsApp, or in-app messaging. Each link includes a secure access code.

Body (provide one):
- `iccid` (string) — ICCID of the eSIM
- `esimId` (string) — eSIM ID (not needed if `iccid` is provided)

```bash
curl --request POST \
  --url 'https://api-dev.getroamify.com/api/esim/link' \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer {access_token}' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{ "iccid": "ICCID_HERE" }'
```

Response includes:
- `url` — e.g. `https://dev.esims.link/acme/4OYONUH79IW1`
- `accessCode` — e.g. `5897`
- `whatsappUrl` — pre-formatted WhatsApp share URL

## eSIM Lifecycle Events — Full eSIM Activity History for Resellers & Support Teams

Source: https://docs.getroamify.com/esims/events/

Endpoint: `GET /api/esim/events`

Retrieve the complete lifecycle event history of an eSIM — from order placement and profile activation to data usage milestones and expiry. Essential for eSIM reseller support teams diagnosing customer issues and for building eSIM lifecycle dashboards.

Query parameters (provide one):
- `iccid` — eSIM ICCID
- `esimId` — Roamify eSIM ID
- `referenceId` — your reference ID from the order

```bash
curl --request GET \
  --url 'https://api-dev.getroamify.com/api/esim/event?iccid=ICCID' \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer {access_token}' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json'
```

Sample Response:
```json
{
  "iccid": "89851000000006262546",
  "esimId": "f6d83dcb-e7b5-45f7-8c1d-b2a07ebd49f4",
  "referenceId": "",
  "events": [...]
}
```

## Create eSIM Gift Card — Issue Travel eSIM Gift Cards via API

Source: https://docs.getroamify.com/gift-cards/create-gift-card/

Endpoint: `POST /api/gifts/gift`

Create a travel eSIM gift card for a customer. Supports 30+ currencies for global eSIM gifting.

Required body:
- `orderId` (string) — your reference order ID
- `senderEmail` (string) — email of the gift card sender
- `amount` (number) — gift card value
- `currency` (string) — ISO 4217 currency code

Optional body:
- `sender` (string) — sender display name

Supported currencies: USD, CAD, EUR, GBP, AUD, CNY, HKD, JPY, SGD, TWD, KRW, AED, MXN, SAR, EGP, RUB, QAR, INR, THB, BGN, BRL, CHF, CZK, DKK, HUF, MYR, NOK, NZD, PLN, RON, SEK

```bash
curl --request POST \
  --url 'https://api-dev.getroamify.com/api/gifts/gift' \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer {access_token}' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data '{
    "orderId": "YOUR_ORDER_ID",
    "senderEmail": "sender@example.com",
    "sender": "John Doe",
    "amount": 50,
    "currency": "USD"
  }'
```

## Webhooks Overview — Real-Time eSIM Event Notifications for Resellers

Source: https://docs.getroamify.com/webhooks/overview/

Roamify webhooks deliver real-time push notifications for critical eSIM and account events. Built for eSIM resellers and travel apps that need instant visibility into eSIM activations, data usage, balance changes, and affiliate sales without polling the API.

Supported event types:
- `esim_usage` — real-time eSIM data usage alerts at configurable consumption thresholds
- `esim_status` — instant eSIM status change notifications (activated, deactivated, suspended, expired)
- `low_balance` / `insufficient_balance` / `top_up` — eSIM reseller wallet balance events
- `order` (affiliate) — eSIM affiliate sale confirmation events

### Mandatory Requirements
- HTTPS endpoint with valid SSL certificate
- Verify `X-Roamify-Signature` HMAC-SHA256 header on every webhook request
- Respond with HTTP 200 within 3 seconds

### Recommended Practices for eSIM Resellers
- Use a message queue for async processing to handle high-volume eSIM events
- Log all incoming webhook requests and responses for audit and debugging
- Implement retry-safe idempotent processing (Roamify retries failed webhooks)
- Test with both valid and invalid payloads and simulate edge cases
- Secure your webhook endpoint with IP allowlisting if possible

### Event Routing Example (JavaScript)
```javascript
if (event_category === 'esim') {
  if (event_type === 'esim_usage') { /* handle usage */ }
  else if (event_type === 'esim_status') { /* handle status */ }
} else if (event_category === 'partner') {
  if (event_type === 'low_balance') { /* handle low balance */ }
  else if (event_type === 'insufficient_balance') { /* handle insufficient */ }
  else if (event_type === 'top_up') { /* handle top-up */ }
} else if (event_category === 'affiliate') {
  if (event_type === 'order') { /* handle affiliate order */ }
}
```

---

## Webhook Signature Verification — Secure eSIM Webhook Authentication

Source: https://docs.getroamify.com/webhooks/verification/

Every Roamify webhook request is signed with HMAC-SHA256. Verify the `X-Roamify-Signature` header before processing any webhook payload to protect your eSIM reseller platform from spoofed or tampered requests.

### Requirements
1. HTTPS endpoint with valid SSL certificate
2. Respond with HTTP 200 within 2 seconds (Roamify retries up to 3 times at increasing intervals)

### Verification — JavaScript
```javascript
const crypto = require('crypto');
const secret = 'your_secret';
const rawBody = req.rawBody;
const signature = req.headers['x-roamify-signature'];

const computedSignature = crypto
  .createHmac('sha256', secret)
  .update(rawBody, 'utf8')
  .digest('hex');

if (computedSignature !== signature) {
  throw new Error('Invalid signature');
}
```

### Verification — PHP
```php
$secret = 'your_secret';
$rawBody = file_get_contents('php://input');
$signature = $_SERVER['HTTP_X_ROAMIFY_SIGNATURE'];

$computedSignature = hash_hmac('sha256', $rawBody, $secret);
if ($computedSignature !== $signature) {
  throw new Exception('Invalid signature');
}
```

### Verification — Python
```python
import hmac
import hashlib

secret = b'your_secret'
raw_body = request.get_data()
signature = request.headers.get('X-Roamify-Signature')

computed = hmac.new(secret, raw_body, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
if computed != signature:
    raise Exception('Invalid signature')
```

## Webhook: eSIM Status Change Events — Real-Time eSIM Activation & Deactivation Alerts

Source: https://docs.getroamify.com/webhooks/types/esim-status/

Triggered instantly when an eSIM changes status. Enables eSIM resellers and travel apps to automate workflows based on eSIM lifecycle events — e.g., notify customers on activation, flag deactivated eSIMs, or trigger renewals on expiry.

Event structure:
- `event_category`: `"esim"`
- `event_type`: `"esim_status"`
- `data.iccid`: eSIM ICCID
- `data.esimId`: Roamify eSIM ID
- `data.status`: new eSIM status

---

## Webhook: eSIM Data Usage Events — Real-Time eSIM Usage Monitoring & Low Data Alerts

Source: https://docs.getroamify.com/webhooks/types/esim-usage/

Triggered at configurable data consumption intervals to report real-time eSIM data usage. Use these events to build proactive low-data warnings and automatic eSIM top-up prompts in your travel app or eSIM reseller dashboard.

Event structure:
- `event_category`: `"esim"`
- `event_type`: `"esim_usage"`
- `data.iccid`: eSIM ICCID
- `data.usedBytes`: bytes consumed
- `data.remainingBytes`: bytes remaining
- `data.totalBytes`: total allocation

---

## Webhook: eSIM Reseller Balance Events — Prepaid Wallet Alerts

Source: https://docs.getroamify.com/webhooks/types/partner-balance/

Triggered on eSIM reseller prepaid wallet balance changes. Use these webhook events to automate balance top-ups and prevent service interruption from insufficient funds when provisioning eSIMs.

Event structure:
- `event_category`: `"partner"`
- `event_type`: `"low_balance"` | `"insufficient_balance"` | `"top_up"`
- `data.balance`: current balance
- `data.currency`: balance currency

---

## Webhook: eSIM Affiliate Order Events — Real-Time eSIM Sale Confirmations

Source: https://docs.getroamify.com/webhooks/types/affiliate-orders/

Triggered instantly when a customer completes an eSIM purchase through your affiliate referral link. Use these events to track affiliate eSIM sales in real time, update commission dashboards, and trigger customer acknowledgement flows.

Event structure:
- `event_category`: `"affiliate"`
- `event_type`: `"order"`
- `data.orderId`: order ID
- `data.amount`: order amount
- `data.commission`: commission earned

---

## eSIM Affiliate Program Overview — Earn Commissions on eSIM Sales

Source: https://docs.getroamify.com/affiliate/overview/

Roamify’s eSIM affiliate API lets travel bloggers, content creators, comparison sites, and app developers earn commissions on every eSIM sale they refer. Get a dedicated API endpoint with pre-built referral links for all global eSIM packages.

Note: Customer MUST click your referral link for the eSIM sale to be tracked and commission to be awarded, regardless of any promo code used.

### eSIM Affiliate Onboarding Flow
1. Get Access Token from the Roamify Partner Portal
2. GET /api/esim/{unique-name}/packages — your dedicated eSIM affiliate endpoint returns all packages with embedded referral links
3. Present eSIM packages to customers using your referral links (website, app, email, social media)
4. Track eSIM affiliate commissions in the Partner Portal — view sales count, revenue, and commission earned

---

Fetch your full eSIM package catalog with your unique affiliate referral link pre-embedded in every package. Your unique partner name is assigned on onboarding. Ideal for building eSIM comparison pages, travel data plan listing sites, and in-app eSIM storefronts.

## Exchange Rates Overview — Real-Time Currency Conversion API for Global eSIM Pricing

Source: https://docs.getroamify.com/exchange-rates/overview/

Roamify Exchange Rates API provides real-time and historical currency exchange rate data for 100+ global currencies. Perfect for eSIM resellers and travel apps that need to display eSIM prices in local currencies, build currency converters, or perform financial analysis.

Supported operations:
- **Supported Currencies** — GET /api/currencies (100+ fiat currencies)
- **Latest Exchange Rates** — GET /api/rates?source=USD&target=EUR (real-time live rates)
- **Historical Exchange Rates** — GET /api/rates?source=USD&target=EUR&datetime=2024-01-01T00:00:00Z
- **Currency Conversion** — convert eSIM pricing between any two currencies using live rates
- **Time-Series Data** — GET /api/rates?source=USD&target=EUR&from=...&to=...&interval=day (trend analysis)

---

## Get Exchange Rates — Live, Historical & Time-Series Currency Rates API

Source: https://docs.getroamify.com/exchange-rates/get-exchange-rates/

Endpoint: `GET /api/rates`

Fetch live exchange rates, historical point-in-time rates, or time-series currency data for any pair of the 100+ supported currencies. Used by eSIM resellers for dynamic local currency pricing and by travel apps for currency conversion features.

Parameters:
- `source` (string, required) — source currency code (e.g. `USD`)
- `target` (string, required) — target currency code (e.g. `EUR`, `JPY`, `AED`)
- `datetime` (string, optional) — ISO 8601 datetime for a historical point-in-time rate. Do NOT combine with `from`/`to`/`interval`.
- `from` (string, optional) — ISO 8601 start date for time-series data. Requires `to` and `interval`.
- `to` (string, optional) — ISO 8601 end date for time-series data. Requires `from` and `interval`.
- `interval` (string, optional) — `day` | `hour` | `minute`. Required when `from`/`to` are provided.

```bash
# Latest rate
curl --request GET \
  --url 'https://api-dev.getroamify.com/api/rates?source=USD&target=EUR' \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer {access_token}' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json'

# Historical rate at a specific datetime
curl --request GET \
  --url 'https://api-dev.getroamify.com/api/rates?source=USD&target=EUR&datetime=2024-01-15T12:00:00Z' \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer {access_token}' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json'

# Time-series data
curl --request GET \
  --url 'https://api-dev.getroamify.com/api/rates?source=USD&target=EUR&from=2024-01-01T00:00:00Z&to=2024-01-07T00:00:00Z&interval=day' \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer {access_token}' \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json'
```
